description: This file defines the interface for system configuration operations related to 'syscfg', including function declarations for initialization, committing changes, retrieving, and setting configuration parameters, as well as related macro definitions.

methods.name: SyscfgCommit
methods.description: Commits any pending changes to the system configuration.

methods.name: SyscfgGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration parameter by name.

methods.name: SyscfgSet
methods.description: Sets the value of a configuration parameter by name.
